name: What materials are used for re-piping?

mainEntity.name: What materials are used for re-piping?

acceptedAnswer.text: For complete water re-pipes, the primary materials used are PEX (cross-linked polyethylene) and copper. Copper piping has been a long-standing standard, known for its durability and resistance to corrosion. PEX piping is a more modern alternative, offering flexibility, heat resistance, and a lower cost, while also being resistant to scale and chlorine. Both materials are excellent choices, and Alpha-Plumbing Services can discuss the pros and cons of each to help you determine the best option for your home's specific needs and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common materials are PEX and copper. Copper is durable and corrosion-resistant, while PEX is flexible, cost-effective, and resistant to scale and chlorine.
